title: Lost in the Fog
skill: Consonant Blends (fr-, gr-, sn-, sp-, st-, tr-, -st, -mp, -ft)
skill_description: Practice reading words with initial blends (fr-, gr-, sn-, sp-, st-, tr-) and final blends (-st, -mp, -ft, -nd).
author: FunBookies
summary: Gus the puppy chases a frog into the fog and gets lost! With the mist swirling around him, he must use his nose and ears to find his way back to Mom. A gentle story about staying calm when things feel scary.

characters.main: Gus: A small golden retriever puppy with fluffy tan fur, floppy ears, a black button nose, and big brown eyes. Curious and energetic but also a bit anxious when scared.
characters.secondary: Mom: A larger golden retriever with warm honey-colored fur, kind eyes, and a calm expression. Patient and loving.

setting_context: A misty park with green grass, tall trees with soft gray fog swirling between them, and a winding dirt path. Morning time with soft diffused light. A small pond nearby where the frog lives.

pages.scene: Medium shot: Small fluffy golden puppy (Gus) with floppy ears and big worried brown eyes stands alone in swirling gray-white fog. Soft green grass beneath his paws, misty trees barely visible in background. The puppy looks small against the vast foggy landscape. Soft diffused morning light, gentle watercolor style with muted greens and warm golden fur. NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS.

pages.text:
Words to Practice:
fog, frog, plop, spot
sniff, step, stop, stuck
lost, trot, jump, glad

Gus was a small pup.
He had soft, tan fluff.
pages.scene: Single scene illustration: Wide shot of cute small golden retriever puppy (Gus) with fluffy tan fur, floppy ears, black button nose, sitting contentedly on green grass in a sunny park. His fur is soft and fluffy, tongue out happily panting. Bright sunny day, blue sky, green trees in background. Warm cheerful atmosphere. One cohesive illustration filling the entire canvas. Gentle watercolor style with soft edges. NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS.

pages.text:
"Stay!" said Mom.
But Gus spots a frog!
pages.scene: Single scene illustration: Medium shot of small golden puppy (Gus) on green grass, ears perked forward, eyes wide and excited, body leaning forward spotting something. Larger golden retriever (Mom) behind him looking concerned. A small green frog sits on a rock near a pond in the distance. Sunny park setting. Gus's body language shows he's about to bolt. One cohesive illustration filling the entire canvas. Gentle watercolor style. NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS.

pages.text:
Plop! The frog hops fast.
Gus runs to grab it!
pages.scene: Single scene illustration: Dynamic medium shot of small golden puppy (Gus) running at full speed across green grass, ears flapping, paws extended mid-stride. A green frog mid-hop ahead of him, splashing into a pond. Motion blur effect on background. Only Gus and the frog in this scene. Energetic, playful atmosphere. One cohesive illustration filling the entire canvas. Gentle watercolor style with movement lines. NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS.

pages.text:
Gus stops.
Fog! Big fog drift in!
pages.scene: Single scene illustration: Wide shot of small golden puppy (Gus) stopped mid-run, looking around with confusion. Thick gray-white fog rolling in from the right side of the image, beginning to obscure the trees. The sunny sky is being swallowed by mist. Gus stands ALONE in the scene. Transition from bright to misty atmosphere. One cohesive illustration filling the entire canvas. Gentle watercolor style with soft fog effects. NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS.

pages.text:
"Mom?" sniffs Gus.
Just mist. Gus is lost!
pages.scene: Single scene illustration: Close-up shot of small golden puppy (Gus) surrounded by thick swirling gray-white fog, eyes wide open showing worry, eyebrows furrowed, ears drooping slightly. His nose is lifted, sniffing the air. He is completely ALONE in dense mist, trees barely visible as gray shapes. Anxious, isolated feeling. One cohesive illustration filling the entire canvas. Soft muted colors, gentle watercolor style. NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS.

pages.text:
Gus steps and steps.
He cannot spot the path.
pages.scene: Single scene illustration: Medium shot of small golden puppy (Gus) walking cautiously through thick fog, one paw lifted mid-step, body low and uncertain. His eyes search left and right, ears alert. Fog swirls around him, obscuring everything. A faint dirt path barely visible beneath his paws disappears into the mist. ALONE in the fog. Lost and searching. One cohesive illustration filling the entire canvas. Gentle watercolor style with misty atmosphere. NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS.

pages.text:
He is stuck.
Gus stops and sits. Sad.
pages.scene: Single scene illustration: Medium shot of small golden puppy (Gus) sitting on the foggy ground, shoulders slumped, head hanging low, ears completely drooped. His posture shows defeat - body hunched, tail curled around himself. Thick gray fog surrounds him. He sits beside a mossy tree stump. ALONE and dejected. Sad, quiet atmosphere. One cohesive illustration filling the entire canvas. Muted colors, gentle watercolor style. NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS.

pages.text:
Sniff, sniff!
What is that? Mom's smell!
pages.scene: Single scene illustration: Close-up shot of small golden puppy (Gus) with nose lifted high in the air, nostrils flared, sniffing intently. His eyes are now bright and alert, ears perking up slightly. His body language shifts from sad to hopeful - head raised, posture straightening. Fog still surrounds him but his expression shows recognition and hope. ALONE but encouraged. One cohesive illustration filling the entire canvas. Gentle watercolor style. NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS.

pages.text:
Gus trots and trots.
The fog lifts!
pages.scene: Single scene illustration: Wide shot of small golden puppy (Gus) trotting confidently forward, nose leading the way, ears bouncing. The fog is lifting and thinning - rays of soft sunlight breaking through, blue sky appearing. Trees becoming clearer, green grass visible again. ALONE but determined, moving toward the clearing. Hopeful, brightening atmosphere. One cohesive illustration filling the entire canvas. Gentle watercolor style with light effects. NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS.

pages.text:
"Mom!" Gus jumps.
A big, soft hug!
pages.scene: Single scene illustration: Medium shot of small golden puppy (Gus) leaping joyfully toward larger golden retriever (Mom), both dogs meeting in an embrace. Mom's front legs wrapping around the small pup, both tails wagging. Gus's face shows pure relief and joy - eyes crinkled, mouth open in happy pant. Fog cleared, sunny park background. Warm, joyful reunion moment. One cohesive illustration filling the entire canvas. Gentle watercolor style with warm golden tones. NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS.

pages.text:
"I was lost," said Gus.
"But I am glad to be back!"
pages.scene: Single scene illustration: Wide shot of small golden puppy (Gus) sitting close beside larger golden retriever (Mom) on green grass in sunny park. Both dogs look content and relaxed. Gus looks up at Mom with grateful eyes, Mom looks down warmly at Gus. Tails resting together. Clear blue sky, green trees, the fog completely gone. Safe, happy, warm family moment. One cohesive illustration filling the entire canvas. Gentle watercolor style with bright cheerful colors. NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS.

pages.text:
Fun Fact!
Dogs have an amazing sense of smell! A dog's nose is 10,000 to 100,000 times better than a human's. That's why Gus could sniff out his mom even in thick fog!

parent_tips.before_reading: Look at the cover together. Ask: 'Have you ever felt lost or couldn't find someone? What did you do?' Talk about how fog makes it hard to see.
parent_tips.during_reading: Help your child sound out blend words like 'sniff' (sn-iff), 'stop' (st-op), and 'trot' (tr-ot). Notice how Gus feels throughout the story - worried, then hopeful, then happy!
parent_tips.after_reading: Ask: 'What helped Gus find his way back?' Talk about using our senses when we're lost. Discuss what to do if your child ever gets separated from you.

comprehension_questions.question: Why did Gus run away from Mom?
comprehension_questions.answer: He saw a frog and wanted to catch it

comprehension_questions.question: What made it hard for Gus to find his way back?
How did Gus feel when he was lost?
How did Gus feel at the end?

reference_prompt:
9-PANEL STYLE REFERENCE SHEET for children's picture book

FOCUS: Character design, setting elements, color palette. Gentle watercolor style, warm and approachable.

Row 1 - GUS THE PUPPY (golden retriever puppy):
[1] Gus front view: Small fluffy golden retriever puppy with soft tan fur, floppy ears, black button nose, big warm brown eyes. Cute and friendly. Sitting pose. Cream background
[2] Gus expressions: Same puppy showing three faces - worried (big eyes, ears back), hopeful (nose up sniffing), joyful (mouth open, eyes crinkled)
[3] Gus running: Same puppy mid-run, ears flapping, paws extended, playful energy

Row 2 - MOM AND KEY MOMENT:
[4] Mom the dog: Larger adult golden retriever with warm honey-colored fur, kind gentle eyes, calm loving expression. Sitting gracefully
[5] KEY IMAGE - GUS LOST IN FOG: Small golden puppy sitting alone in thick swirling gray-white fog, shoulders slumped, head down, ears drooping. Isolated, sad moment
[6] Puppy sniffing: Gus with nose lifted high, nostrils flared, eyes bright with recognition. Hope returning

Row 3 - MISTY PARK SETTING:
[7] Foggy forest: Tall trees fading into thick gray-white mist, soft green grass barely visible, mysterious atmosphere
[8] Park clearing: Sunny green park with grass, trees, blue sky, warm sunlight. The safe home base
[9] Happy reunion: Small Gus and larger Mom together, Gus nuzzled against Mom, both tails wagging, warm loving moment

STYLE: Gentle watercolor illustration style. Soft edges, warm color palette: golden fur tones, soft greens, misty grays, warm cream backgrounds. NOT harsh or scary. Cozy, comforting despite the fog scenes. Style similar to Beatrix Potter or contemporary gentle picture books.

LAYOUT: 3x3 grid, thin white borders between panels.

CRITICAL: NO TEXT, NO WORDS, NO LETTERS anywhere. Pure illustration only.
